gloss_en: Model Checker rejects my IFC with IFC0000104 'File contains invalid or incomplete IFC data': ContextOfItems is required.
question_paraphrase: portal says IfcShapeRepresentation.ContextOfItems is required, code IFC0000104, which shape and how to fix without re-exporting
phrasing_notes: error code quoted verbatim; portal wording copied
answer_summary: Link the shape to the single matching geometric context; if zero or several contexts match, report only.

gloss_en: Portal says IfcClosedShell.CfsFaces must not be empty; exporter wrote an empty closed shell.
question_paraphrase: IfcClosedShell.CfsFaces must not be empty from the checker, IFCCLOSEDSHELL(()) in file, what to do
answer_summary: Remove empty shell and its wrapping brep, keep the element; re-run checker.

gloss_en: Error IFC0000101 'Update file to a supported IFC version' because I exported IFC2x3.
question_paraphrase: got IFC0000101 update file to supported IFC version, I exported ifc2x3, how to export ifc4 with IFC+SG settings
answer_summary: CORENET X IFC+SG requires IFC4; cannot be repaired, re-export as IFC4 with IFC+SG settings.

gloss_en: Some rooms/spaces export without geometry; why: no area, zero area, zero height?
question_paraphrase: list of rooms with no shape in IFC, element id and guid, why no 3D shape exported
phrasing_notes: asks for ids/GUIDs to locate in authoring tool
answer_summary: Causes: area but no 3D shape exported, area 0 (unenclosed/redundant), height 0, no area data.

gloss_en: Project has two shared parameters with same name but different GUIDs (old vs approved IFC+SG one); which one gets exported?
question_paraphrase: duplicate IFC+SG shared parameters same name different guid in my Revit model, values split between old and new, how to merge
answer_summary: Revit cannot change GUID of existing shared parameter; copy values to approved parameter then delete old; check schedules/filters/Dynamo using old GUID.

gloss_en: Door ClearWidth stored as text '1000 mm' and FireRating as '1 hr' fail mapping; expected numeric value.
question_paraphrase: ClearWidth is '1000 mm' text and FireRating '1 hr', mapping wants number, how to bulk fix
answer_summary: Convert to numeric with unit carried separately; check required psets/type/format.

gloss_en: Elements contained only to building/site not storey; missing IfcMapConversion; duplicate GlobalIds.
question_paraphrase: which elements are not in a storey, no IfcMapConversion, duplicate GlobalId before CORENET X
answer_summary: Flags elements without storey ancestor, missing IfcMapConversion, duplicate GlobalIds, non-unique storey names.

gloss_en: How to check IFC georeferencing: SVY21 EPSG:3414, SITEBOUNDARY IfcGeographicElement, coordinates inside Singapore.
question_paraphrase: is my ifc georeferenced to SVY21 EPSG 3414, do i need SITEBOUNDARY IfcGeographicElement
answer_summary: Check IfcProjectedCRS = EPSG:3414, IfcGeographicElement ObjectType=SITEBOUNDARY, placement within SG E/N bounds after unit conversion.

gloss_en: Site coverage, site boundary and planting areas modelled as IfcSpace; need IfcBuildingElementProxy / IfcGeographicElement.
question_paraphrase: site coverage and site boundary came out as IfcSpace, IFC+SG wants IfcGeographicElement, relationships too
answer_summary: Convert spaces by long name: Site Coverage->IfcBuildingElementProxy, Site Boundary/Planting->IfcGeographicElement; fix relationships.

gloss_en: Stair flights lack number of risers/treads, riser height, tread length attributes required by IFC+SG.
question_paraphrase: stair flights missing riser count tread length riser height, can it be filled from geometry
answer_summary: Derive from straight-flight geometry and parent stair data; flag curved/spiral for manual review.

gloss_en: Unofficial pre-flight checker against CORENET X Code of Practice editions COP 3.1 and COP 4, exporting BCF.
question_paraphrase: pre-check ifc+sg against COP 3.1 or COP 4 before submitting, select failing elements, export bcf
answer_summary: Offline rule catalogues; reports as text/CSV/JSON/HTML/BCF; not a compliance decision.

gloss_en: Official IFC+SG pages: onboarding checklist, data structure, Excel mapping file, authoring tools, glossary of identified components.
question_paraphrase: what is IFC+SG, data structure, excel mapping file, authoring tools and plug-ins
answer_summary: Site lists Excel Mapping File, BIM Authoring Tools, Plug-In and 3rd Party Tools, Model Checker, Code of Practice.

gloss_en: Auto-fill derivable properties: slab thickness, beam depth, MaterialGrade C50 -> C50/60, ConstructionMethod in situ -> CIS.
question_paraphrase: MaterialGrade from StrengthClass C50 to C50/60, ConstructionMethod CIS or PC from casting method
answer_summary: Fill from geometry bbox/EN 206 pairing, log GlobalId and source, preserve existing values; gaps in SGPset_BeamReinforcement and SteelConnection.

gloss_en: Kit that gives an LLM a Revit troubleshooting playbook plus Singapore CORENET X / IFC-SG context.
question_paraphrase: AI revit coach with singapore corenet x ifc-sg context, describe goal not just symptom
answer_summary: Instructions plus knowledge files (my-setup, troubleshooting playbook, singapore-bim-context); upload firm BIM manual.

gloss_en: Check the IFC for causes of IFC0000104 before CX submission
prompt: cx submission tomorrow, checker gave IFC0000104. find shapes w/o ContextOfItems and empty IfcClosedShell in this ifc
expected_behavior: Scan IfcShapeRepresentation without ContextOfItems and IfcClosedShell with empty CfsFaces; list GlobalIds and names; propose fixes without deleting elements.

gloss_en: Confirm schema version
prompt: is this file ifc4 or 2x3? corenet x only takes ifc4 right
expected_behavior: Read FILE_SCHEMA header, state the version, confirm CORENET X IFC+SG expects IFC4, advise re-export if not.

gloss_en: Check georeferencing is SVY21
prompt: check georef - SVY21 3414? and is there a SITEBOUNDARY object
expected_behavior: Inspect IfcMapConversion / IfcProjectedCRS name for EPSG:3414, find IfcGeographicElement with ObjectType SITEBOUNDARY, verify site placement plausible for Singapore and units.

gloss_en: Find site objects modelled as IfcSpace
prompt: site coverage, planting area, site boundary - are they IfcSpace in here? should be proxy / geographic element
expected_behavior: List IfcSpace whose LongName matches those names, report their correct IFC+SG classes, offer to convert and repair relationships.

gloss_en: List elements not contained in a storey
prompt: which elems arent assigned to a storey? only building/site level
expected_behavior: Walk IfcRelContainedInSpatialStructure, list elements whose container is IfcBuilding or IfcSite or none, grouped by class; also check duplicate storey names/elevations.

gloss_en: Find text values with units in numeric properties
prompt: any door props like ClearWidth with '1000 mm' strings instead of numbers?
expected_behavior: Scan door psets for IfcText values containing digits plus unit text where numeric expected; report GlobalId, property, current value, proposed numeric value.

gloss_en: Report missing SGPset properties on beams and slabs
prompt: what SGPset_Beam / SGPset_Slab props are missing on the structure? count per class
expected_behavior: For IfcBeam and IfcSlab, check presence of SGPset_Beam, SGPset_Slab, reinforcement psets and required properties; give counts and sample GlobalIds.

gloss_en: Spaces with zero area or no geometry
prompt: list spaces with no geometry or area 0, with guid so i can find them in revit
expected_behavior: Find IfcSpace with no Representation, zero NetFloorArea or height; output name, number, GlobalId, likely cause.

gloss_en: Duplicate IFC+SG shared parameters in Revit
prompt: revit has 2 shared params w same name diff guid for IFC+SG. list them and say which elements have values in the old one
expected_behavior: Enumerate shared parameters, group by name with differing GUIDs, count elements with values in each, flag conflicts; do not delete before confirmation.

gloss_en: Fill missing stair flight attributes
prompt: stair flights are missing riser count/height n tread length. fill what u can from geometry, flag the curved ones
expected_behavior: Compute values for straight flights from geometry, write attributes, list ambiguous spiral/curved stairs for manual review.

gloss_en: Check duplicate GlobalIds
expected_behavior: Find duplicate GlobalIds across all rooted entities, list pairs with class and name.

gloss_en: Compare resubmission with previous
prompt: compare v3 and v4 ifc, what changed in classes and psets since last cx submission?
expected_behavior: Diff two IFC files by GlobalId: added, removed, changed class/property sets; summarize.

gloss_en: How to export from Revit for CORENET X
prompt: new to corenet x, how do i set up revit for ifc-sg export? template? shared params? ifc4?
expected_behavior: Explain loading IFC+SG template/shared parameters, IFC4 export setup, class mapping, then running the Model Checker; note to check current official guidance.

gloss_en: Archicad or Tekla IFC+SG mapping
prompt: using archicad/tekla not revit - how do i map to ifc+sg psets? any plugin?
expected_behavior: Explain the IFC+SG Excel mapping file and authoring-tool guidance on the official site; suggest property mapping/translators; verify with checker.
